lines.2: 「Oh, Yoppi's carrying books. That's our student council secretary. Keep it up!」
lines.5: 「Oh, Murata. I'm fine, really. I can carry them by myself.」
lines.6: 「Are you sure? We may be in different classes, but we're both class representatives. Don't hesitate to ask.」
lines.7: 「Unfortunately, you're the representative of that league of supreme idiots, Class 2-C. I can only imagine the stress that causes.」
lines.8: 「Yes, but I can manage by myself.」
lines.9: 「A-and they certainly cause me trouble, but I'd rather you didn't call everyone idiots.」
lines.10: 「Hm. That was out of line. Sorry.」
lines.12: All right, time to head home...
lines.14: Sato is carrying a heavy-looking stack of books.
lines.17: 「Ngh... Wow, these books are pretty heavy.」
lines.18: I take more than half the books she was carrying.
lines.19: 「Wow, that made it so much lighter. Thank you!」
lines.20: 「Did you bring them from the library?」
lines.21: 「Yes. We're working on converting all the old records into data.」
lines.22: Together, we carry the records to the executive committee room.
lines.24: 「Turning all this into a database? That's a lot of work.」
lines.29: 「These records are really old. Don't we have to go all the way to the room at the back of the library building?」
lines.30: 「I'm the executive committee secretary. I have the key.」
lines.31: She jingles the keys for me.
lines.32: 「I see. The job gives you access to more places, but also more kinds of work.」
lines.33: 「Ahaha. But in return, if an old book is no longer needed and looks interesting, I can keep it.」
lines.34: 「Sato, that's dirty. Pretty crafty of you.」
lines.38: 「No, no no no no no no no! I... I-- ngh...! Am I... d-d-dir-ty...? No... I'm not.」
lines.47: 「I didn't want you to say something like that to me, Tsushima... I lost control. I'm sorry...」
lines.49: Oh no. What have I done?
lines.51: In any age, a man must never make a girl cry.
lines.53: I apologize with all my heart.
lines.55: 「I was a little too sensitive... I-I'm sorry too.」
lines.60: 「Ahaha... We're caught in an apology loop.」
lines.62: 「Then c-can we say this was your fault, Tsushima?」
lines.64: 「W-we'll never get anywhere like this... Why don't we clear our heads over tea at a cafe? If you buy me something, we'll call it even.」
lines.66: Thank goodness. She's back to her usual self.
lines.67: People are delicate. I am too. A stray word can hurt someone terribly.
